consumer: mission::is_complete for the MGOAL_FIND_ITEM delivery mission, asking 'does the player hold the required package item in the count the mission demands' to decide if it can be turned in to the contact.
scope: items reachable via the player's crafting_inventory() (own carried items plus items reachable nearby), NOT only on-person carried items.
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — checks u.crafting_inventory().has_amount/has_charges(type->item_id, item_count) to compute the mission-completion yes/no the engine acts on.
divergence: The required package item sits in an adjacent tile/nearby container within crafting_inventory() reach but is NOT in the avatar's wielded/worn/inventory items: mission::is_complete returns true (can turn in), but a carried-items-only export (Excerpt 2) or on-person has_items check (Excerpt 3) wrongly returns false.
